scheme_name: Economic Help To Tribal Girls For Higher Education (Class 11 & 12)
other_conditions: Student must be studying regularly in 11th and 12th in government schools
Parent/guardian/husband should not be an income tax payer
Student must be a native of Rajasthan
Students residing in government-run hostels are not eligible for the benefit
benefits_summary: One‑time payment of Rs. 3,500 in July.
